entries.14582743d1eafe48: The main business is investment and financial services, with securities as its core products. The company engages in trading of securities, brokerage of securities transactions, underwriting and secondary offerings of securities, handling of public offerings and secondary offerings of securities, and other financial instruments business. There is only one reportable segment. The company has its head office in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo and 28 branches and sales offices nationwide, and operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥21,725 million.
